knee-hug-rock.name: Knee hug rock
knee-hug-rock.cue: Lie on your back, hug your knees, and rock gently side to side.
knee-hug-rock.description: Lie on your back (in bed is fine) and pull your knees to your chest. Rock gently side to side. It is a wake-up signal for the spine, not a stretch.

cat-cow.name: Cat-cow
cat-cow.cue: On hands and knees, slowly round and arch your spine.
cat-cow.description: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips. Alternate rounding your back up and arching it down while you lift your head. Slow, full range.

neck-circles.name: Neck circles
neck-circles.description: Controlled neck rotations (CARs). Three slow circles each way; feel every position on the way and never force your head back.

shoulder-circles.name: Shoulder circles
shoulder-circles.description: Shoulder CARs. Three circles each way, as wide as you can, keeping your shoulders away from your ears.

hip-circles.name: Hip circles
hip-circles.cue: Lift your knee and draw a big circle. Hold a wall if you need to.
hip-circles.description: Hip CARs. Stand on one leg, lift the other knee and draw a wide circle: three one way, three the other. Keep your torso still.

ankle-circles.name: Ankle circles
ankle-circles.cue: Three circles each way, to the end of your range.
ankle-circles.description: Ankle CARs. Lift one foot and circle the ankle three times each way, slowly, to the end of your range.

deep-squat.name: Deep squat
deep-squat.cue: Sink low and stay there. Shift your weight side to side.
deep-squat.description: Sink as low as you comfortably can and stay at the bottom, shifting your weight side to side. If your knees complain, go less deep.

worlds-greatest-stretch.name: World's greatest stretch
worlds-greatest-stretch.cue: Lunge, hand inside your front foot, then rotate the other arm to the ceiling.
worlds-greatest-stretch.description: From a lunge, put the hand on the front-leg side inside your front foot and rotate the other arm up to the ceiling. Keep the back knee under control.

dog-to-cobra.name: Downward dog to cobra
dog-to-cobra.cue: Flow between both. Heels down in dog, hips forward in cobra.
dog-to-cobra.description: Flow between downward dog and cobra. In dog, press your heels toward the floor; in cobra, push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes. Don't sink into your shoulders.

standing-side-bend.name: Standing side bend
standing-side-bend.cue: One arm overhead, bend to the opposite side.
standing-side-bend.description: Reach one arm overhead and bend to the opposite side. Breathe into the stretched side and don't lean forward.

hinge-to-reach.name: Hinge to reach
hinge-to-reach.cue: Hinge from the hips, then stand tall and reach overhead.
hinge-to-reach.description: Hinge from the hips like a Romanian deadlift with a flat back, then stand tall and reach both arms overhead. Smooth, with your breath.

relaxed-deep-squat.name: Relaxed deep squat
relaxed-deep-squat.cue: Close your eyes. Don't chase depth, just breathe.
relaxed-deep-squat.description: A long, easy squat with your eyes closed. Don't chase depth or a stretch; the point is to slow down and breathe.

butterfly-pulses.name: Butterfly pulses
butterfly-pulses.cue: Soles together, hold your feet. Gently fold forward and come back up.
butterfly-pulses.description: Sit with the soles of your feet together and hold them. Fold gently forward breathing in, come back up breathing out. No pulling or bouncing.

frog-pose.name: Frog pose
frog-pose.cue: Knees wide, gently rock forward and back. Choose your range.
frog-pose.description: On all fours with your knees wide (wider is more intense) and feet in line with the knees or a little wider. Rock gently forward and back. The most intense position of the evening, so choose your range.

childs-pose.name: Child's pose
childs-pose.cue: Knees wide, reach forward, forehead down. Let your lower back release.
childs-pose.description: Knees wide, feet almost together. Reach your arms far forward and rest your forehead on the floor. Let your lower back release, and come out of it slowly.
